createError: The game could not be saved. Try again.
discoveryIntro: Pass the device around the table in seating order. Each player checks their name, taps the token to see their character, then hides it before passing the device on.
discoveryReturnHelp: Hand the device back to the Storyteller. Opening the grimoire will show everyone's characters.
discoveryNext: Hide and pass to next player
discoveryUnavailable: Assign a character to every seat before discovering characters.
drawIntro: Pass the device around the table in seating order. Each player checks their name, taps one of the face-down tokens to see their character, then hides it before passing the device on.
drawEmptySeats: The seats without a token stay empty.
drawDealHelp: Hand the device back to the Storyteller, who deals the tokens onto the grimoire.
drawReturnHelp: Hand the device back to the Storyteller. The tokens already drawn stay set aside until the deal.
drawUnavailable: There is no bag to draw from.
shuffleUnavailable: This script cannot fill these seats with a matching setup. Your selection is unchanged. Choose characters manually or change the player count.
prepareDrunk: The player who draws this token sees a Townsfolk that is not in the bag. The grimoire then shows that Townsfolk with the Drunk's reminder.
prepareLunatic: The player who draws this token sees the Demon in the bag.
prepareMarionette: The player who draws this token sees a Townsfolk that is not in the bag. The grimoire then shows that Townsfolk with the Marionette's reminder. This player must neighbor the Demon. With a Summoner or Lil' Monsta, resolve the jinx first.
prepareBountyHunter: Choose one Townsfolk to start evil and record their alignment.
prepareAbilities: Choose the granted ability and apply any setup changes it requires.
prepareHermit: Review the script's Outsider abilities and their jinxes for this player.
prepareKazali: The bag starts without Minions. On the first night, record the Minions chosen by the Kazali.
prepareTyphon: Arrange the evil characters in a continuous line, with the Lord of Typhon between Minions, before revealing characters.
prepareLilMonsta: Lil' Monsta stays outside the seats, and an extra Minion takes the Demon's seat. Each night, put the Is The Demon reminder on the player babysitting it.
looseNote: On the board from the start, outside the seats.
prepareHomebrew: Review this homebrew character's setup and apply any required changes.
prepareVillageIdiot: Choose one of the extra Village Idiots to be drunk and mark that player.
